title: BBy to Launch in San Francisco, First Marketplace App for Safe Breast Milk
summary: Breast Milk Condensing Solutions for Hospitals
body_markdown:
**BBy to Launch in San Francisco, First Marketplace App for Safe Breast Milk** *App to Go Live in San Francisco in November 2017*


**New York, NY – October 26, 2017 –** BBy, the physician-created app that establishes a safe and reliable marketplace for breast milk, today announced its expansion into the San Francisco market. Launching in November 2017, San Francisco will serve as the third market for BBy. It is the first app to provide a regulated marketplace for breast milk.


Available on iOS and Android, BBy’s app will support both nursing mothers and new parents in the San Francisco metro area. Parents who are interested in feeding their child natural breast milk, but are unable to produce milk themselves, can access local, rigorously tested supply through the app. Nursing mothers with an excess supply can sign up on the app and, once approved by BBy’s team, be matched with potential buyers. BBy is the only physician approved marketplace that ensures all sellers are pre-screened and free of transmittable diseases, including: HIV, Hepatitis, TORChES and more. After successfully matching, each milk delivery is conducted by the donor, fostering a sense of community and inter-personal relationship.


“The idea for BBy was forged in light of my experience as a doctor, reflecting my understanding of the health benefits breast milk provides to infants,” said Dr. Vansh Langer, founder and CEO of BBy. “Every parent who wants to provide their child with the natural benefits of breast milk should be able to do so. Yet, finding a safe supply can be quite difficult. BBy’s app provides parents access to safe and rigorously tested breast milk, while creating an opportunity for nursing mothers to provide nutrients to other children and generate extra income. BBy was created with one goal in mind: to help families access natural breast milk in a safe and affordable manner.”


The concept was born in Chicago, where Dr. Langer worked with adoptive parents to nurse their three-week-old baby back to health. Dr. Langer asked another mother to give the baby her breast milk – which she previously had not had access to – and, the active immunities in the milk helped her make a full recovery. Dr. Langer noticed that supply and availability of natural breast milk was a top concern for new parents not producing enough, or any. Yet, some new mothers produced so much milk, they were simply throwing the excess away. BBy, the app Dr. Langer created, provides a connection between these buyers and sellers and offers a quality product sold at a cost per ounce less than premium formula, with 80% of the transaction given directly to the selling mother.


BBy conducted a successful pilot program in Chicago in 2016, and is live in the Chicago and New York markets. The app is available for download in the App Store and Google Play Store. For more information on BBy, please visit:[http://bbyworld.com/](http://bbyworld.com/) .


**About BBy**


BBy is a physician-created app that establishes a safe and reliable marketplace for breast milk. It is the first app to connect nursing mothers to new parents, providing a supply of quality breast milk that has been rigorously tested. BBy, which is available on iOS and Android, connects buyers and sellers in local communities for a cost per ounce less than premium formula. The service, which is currently available in New York and Chicago, completed a pilot program in December 2016 with over 700 infants nurtured. BBy will launch in San Francisco in November 2017, with plans to expand to additional markets in 2018. For more information on BBy and how to help nurture the future, visit our website:[http://bbyworld.com/](http://bbyworld.com/) .
